decisionsTitle: A minor signs the group-run declaration with a parent
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-14:** «pt alergările de grup trebuie să facem declarația să suporte și un minor, o bifă nouă și să semneze minorul + părintele». And, the same afternoon, «it's YOLO man»: the open points below were decided without asking. Amends §393 (the optional group-run declarations), §523 (one declaration for a whole series) and §330 (the minor's own signature and the parent's), and builds on §440 and §515 (the run's age) and §562 / §613 (a marker in a text in force is the switch).

**What it is.** On a group run's signing page a new tick, «Semnez pentru un minor (sub 18 ani)» / «I am signing for a minor (under 18)». Ticked, the page asks what the race's §330 page asks of two signers: the minor's own typed name, as their signature, and the parent's or guardian's tick «Sunt părintele sau tutorele legal și sunt de acord»; the parent's own typed name is the page's signature box, as the declarant's is the race's. The minor's boxes are an island (`MinorSigningFields`, the shape of `GuardianForMinor`; not `OnlyWhenTicked`, which still posts what is hidden): closed until the tick is ticked, always open with scripts off, and — once the page is interactive — a closed block is a disabled `fieldset` and the tick alone decides whether it is open, so a name typed and then un-ticked (after a refusal too) is never posted. The tick is drawn before the consent box that points to it, and the box says the adult's age as well: «…pentru mine, având cel puțin {age} împliniți, sau pentru minorul bifat mai sus». The page says above the text that the minor's paragraphs apply only when the tick is ticked. The refusal summary, the focusable error box and the kept-form recall are the page's own; the tick, both ticks and the minor's name come back after a refusal.

**Storage: the same row, one added column, no second table.** The brief assumed a group-run acceptance lives on `declaration_acceptances`; it does not: that table's `registration_id` is not null and means "this registration may be confirmed", and a group run takes no registration (§111, §393), so §393 gave it a table of its own, `group_run_declarations`. §330's two signatures are kept there the way §330 keeps them on the race's row: `typed_name` is the declarant — the adult's own name, or the parent's or guardian's when a minor signs —, and the new nullable `minor_typed_name` (migration `0155`, expand only, numbered after the checkpoints migrations `0153` and `0154`) is the minor's own signature. No identity-document column for the minor: no group-run text names one (§418) and a child's identity number has no business here (GDPR art. 5(1)(c)). The minor's birth date is counted on the run's day and dropped, as §440's is: it must reach the run's minimum and be **under eighteen** (the tick says «sub 18 ani», and the race decides who is a minor from the date, `isMinorOn`), so an adult's date is refused with a marker of its own (`tooOld`) and its own words, while the minor's box says the same live from the oldest minor's birth date (`oldestMinorBirthDate`, `BirthDateField`'s `tooOld`). The signer's key (`signer_key`, the unique index of §523) carries the minor's name, so one parent's two children, or a parent's own declaration and a child's, are separate signatures, and the same child pressed twice is the kept one.

**The age: the run's own number.** A run takes a minor when its own minimum age (§329, never under fourteen, §515) is under eighteen; the adult's declaration is still read at eighteen (`groupRunMinimumAge`). A run saved with the default fourteen therefore takes minors from fourteen once the text allows it — which is what its page and its structured data already said (`EventAgeRule`), while the declaration read it as eighteen; a run for adults only sets 18 or more in «Regulamentul». The minor's birth date is asked on that path and refused under the minimum with the number said, as the race's door does.

**The template, and the switch.** Both group-run texts, both languages, gain: a paragraph (behind `{{minor}}`) where the minor signs for themselves and the parent approves in advance (Codul civil art. 41 alin. (2)) and accepts the risks and the waiver for the minor «în limitele permise de lege», never for harm the club causes (art. 1355) — the pattern of the race's §330 paragraph; a short paragraph (behind `{{minor}}`) on the minor's data; the minimum age as its own field, `{{minorMinimumAge}}`, which is "" on a run for adults and drops the paragraph; and the adult's sentence, «Eu, {{signerAlone}}, semnez această declarație personal, doar pentru mine», now a sentence of its own that a minor's declaration loses (as its age sentence, `{{minimumAge}}`, does). The renderer already drops a paragraph whose field is "" (`PARAGRAPH_MERGE_FIELDS`), so one approved text serves both paths; the signing page shows both ways with dotted blanks, so each signer reads the paragraphs that apply to them, and the signed PDF keeps one. Template only: no text in force moves and nothing is approved for the club (§29, §95); the Administrators are told by the §639 email. **The tick is shown only while the group-run text of the run's kind in force names `{{minor}}` in every language** (`namesGroupRunMinor`, `groupRunMinorPathOffered`: §562's and §613's pattern, `asksForMinorSignature`'s for the race) and the run takes minors; `/admin/tasks` carries the row `groupRunMinorText` (open, never blocking, done by itself), and `docs/RUNBOOKS.md` § Legal document version says the steps. A post that ticks it where it is not offered is refused on the tick's own box.

**The PDF and the emails.** The signed PDF draws both signatures with the race's own block (`signature.minor`, §330): «DREPT PENTRU CARE SEMNĂM», the minor's signature then the parent's under one date, no identity-document line; the blanks are filled through the race's `declarantValues` and `identityDocumentValues` (`{{participant}}` the minor, `{{guardian}}` the parent), and the method line says two people signed. The signer's copy and the club's archive copy name both; the archive subject reads «… (pentru minorul …)».

**The backoffice.** A minor's row in «Declarații semnate (alergare de grup)» is listed under the minor's name with «minor · părinte: <name>»; the erase, the hold and the PDF are unchanged.

**Decided without asking (YOLO), and refused.** (1) The minor's birth date is asked, the run's minimum enforced and eighteen refused — refused: letting a parent tick the box with no age check, which would make the event's «Vârsta minimă» mean nothing on this page, or letting an adult's date be stored as a minor's declaration. (2) The text is one text with two paths, not a third template — refused: a third text per surface for the same risks, to approve and keep in step. (3) A box of the minor's filled while the tick is not ticked is refused on the tick, not ignored — refused: signing an adult's declaration («am cel puțin 18 ani») over a child's name. (4) No minor's identity document or number, and no second table. (5) The privacy-notice template gains two sentences — the minor's name is kept on the same row, the birth date is checked and not kept — so the notice the club approves says what the declaration keeps; nothing waits on it beyond the club approving both texts in one sitting. Also decided after the review: the minor's tick waits only for the declaration's `{{minor}}` marker, not for a privacy notice that describes the minor's name — §330's precedent, and the declaration carries its own minor's-data paragraph; the minor's boxes are not marked `required` once the page is interactive — the server stays the authority and the island would have to reach into server-drawn controls; the migration's number is the next free one after every sibling and its `when` is later than theirs. Not decided here, for the club and its lawyer: whether a parent's single tick is enough evidence of authority over the child, or the club wants the parent's identity document back for a minor (the race asks it, §330); and whether the minor's name should leave the row at the same sweep as the parent's (today both leave only by the Administrator's erase, §503, §556).
changelogLine: - **A minor signs a group run's declaration, with a parent** — a new tick «Semnez pentru un minor (sub 18 ani)» on the signing page opens the minor's own signature and the parent's tick; both names are kept on the one row, the PDF carries both signatures, and a minor's row in the backoffice reads «minor · părinte: …». It appears only on a run whose minimum age is under 18, once a group-run declaration naming the minor's paragraph is in force — approve the new templates; `/admin/tasks` says when. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a group run whose own minimum age is under eighteen and a group-run declaration of its kind in force that names `{{minor}}` in both languages, when its signing page renders, then it offers the tick «Semnez pentru un minor (sub 18 ani)», which opens the minor's own typed name, the minor's birth date (counted against the run's minimum on the run's day and never kept) and the parent's tick «Sunt părintele sau tutorele legal și sunt de acord»; the parent's own name is the page's signature box. The boxes are always present with scripts off, and once the page is interactive a closed block is disabled and not posted, a refusal included. The tick is drawn before the consent box. Under a text that does not name `{{minor}}`, in either language, or on a run whose minimum age is eighteen or more, the tick is not drawn and a post that ticks it is refused on the tick's box, nothing written (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a group-run signing with the minor's tick ticked, then the minor's name and the parent's tick are both required and the minor's birth date must be under eighteen and at least the run's minimum on the run's day (a date of eighteen or more is refused on its box with its own words, and said live under the box), each refused by its own box name with nothing written; given the tick not ticked, none is asked, and a minor's box filled while it is not is refused on the tick. A refusal brings the tick, the minor's name, the parent's tick and the typed boxes back, as every box of that form (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a minor's group-run declaration, then one `group_run_declarations` row keeps the parent's or guardian's name in `typed_name` and the minor's own signature in the nullable `minor_typed_name`, with no identity document and no second table; the same address and parent signing for the same child again writes no second row, while a second child, or the parent's own declaration, is another row (`signer_key` carries the minor's name) (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the platform's two group-run templates, in both languages, then each carries the minor's two paragraphs behind `{{minor}}` — who signs, with the parent's approval and acceptance «în limitele permise de lege» and never for the organiser's own fault, and the minor's data — and the adult's sentence behind `{{signerAlone}}`; the minor's minimum is `{{minorMinimumAge}}`, "" on a run for adults, which drops its paragraph. A minor's declaration loses the adult's sentence and age sentence, an adult's loses the minor's paragraphs; the page shows both ways with dotted blanks (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a minor's group-run declaration, when its PDF is rendered, then it draws both signatures with the race's block — the minor's, then the parent's, under one date, no identity-document line — with `{{participant}}` the minor and `{{guardian}}` the parent, and the signer's copy and the club's archive copy both name the minor and the parent; in the backoffice's list the row reads «minor · părinte: <name>» (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

`/admin/tasks` shows «Declarațiile alergărilor de grup: minorul și părintele» as open while a group-run text in force does not name `{{minor}}`, as done when every one does, and not at all while none is in force; it is never blocking (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 30. The adult's own group-run declaration still reads a minimum under eighteen as eighteen (`groupRunMinimumAge`); a group run whose own minimum age is under eighteen also takes a minor, who signs beside a parent on a path of its own, once a text naming `{{minor}}` is in force (2026-10-14, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `group-run-declarations/minor-path.test.ts`; integration `group-run-declarations/minor.test.ts`; e2e `group-run-declaration.spec.ts`.
